responsibility: Implements RTL dead code elimination, including the fast DF-driven register-level pass, word-level DCE, and helper entry points used from the dataflow framework. It determines which insns are deletable, marks needed instructions by tracing data/control dependencies and debug requirements, iterates backward liveness over basic blocks using DF LR or word-LR problems, removes unmarked insns, and performs associated CFG cleanup and exception-edge handling when dead instructions or dead calls are deleted.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL dead-code-elimination passes declared in gcc/dce.h. Unlike the header’s small set of entry-point declarations, this source file contains the actual insn deletability tests, dependency marking/worklist processing, block-level liveness-driven fast and word-level DCE algorithms, CFG-sensitive call deletion logic, and pass objects.
